ModMetaData.name: Gendered Moral Guide Titles
ModMetaData.author: Cruesoe
ModMetaData.description:
Moral Guide roles get male and female titles, the same way Leader already does.
New ideoligions generate a female form when the noun has one (priest / priestess, abbot / abbess). Assigned pawns show the title that matches their gender. The ideoligion editor has separate male and female name fields.
Requires Ideology.
